target: Original complete fixed response plus EOS, same scalar log-probability target and same native model input for every variant.
reference: Original eligible-token EOS reference; no query rescaling, no grouping or target selection in the variants.

rules.DT_endpoint_symmetric: Half the forward signed vector minus half the vector from the same two complete endpoints in reverse order.
rules.DT_gate_symmetric: Symmetric normalized-content times SiLU gate product at every GDN layer; memory recurrence unchanged.
rules.DT_memory_symmetric: Average both endpoint orders of the local memory recurrence at every GDN layer; output gate unchanged.
rules.DT_gdn_symmetric: Both preceding GDN changes, uniformly at every GDN layer.

metrics: Original signed RISE, positive-part MAS and original NIAH 10% token Recall. Report all candidates, including regressions.
selection_rule: No selection in validation: candidate is already frozen. Report every task and paired metric.
validation: Freeze the candidate before a separate deterministic construction of novel keys and values and before broader task checks. Original 600 benchmark cases have been inspected and are not an untouched holdout.
validation_success: Macro paired RISE improves with a task-stratified bootstrap 95% upper bound below zero, while macro MAS and Recall do not worsen in mean. Inspect and report individual task regressions separately.

bootstrap.unit: Paired cases, sampled within each of six tasks; equal task mean weighting.

runtime_validation: Repeat original DT after the candidate on every example; repeat the candidate on the first example. Do not relax the existing 1e-4 vector consistency threshold.
